invoice.name: Free Invoice Generator
invoice.text: No signup needed. Add your company, pick a template, set tax and download the PDF. Your data stays on your device.

discount.name: Discount Calculator
discount.text: Enter the original price and the discount to see the amount you save and the final price instantly.

salestax.name: Sales Tax Calculator
salestax.text: Add sales tax to a price or remove it from a total in one tap. Free, no signup.

vat.name: VAT Calculator
vat.text: Add or remove VAT from any amount and see net, VAT and gross instantly.

pdf.name: Online PDF Suite
pdf.text: Convert images to PDF and manage your PDF files in your browser. Free, no signup.

sign.name: Sign PDF Online
sign.text: Draw your signature, place it on the page and download the signed PDF. Free, no signup.

tax.name: VAT Analytics
tax.text: See the VAT you owe and the VAT you can reclaim from your income and expenses at a glance.

pdftext.name: PDF Text Editor
pdftext.text: Scan a PDF, tap a line, replace or delete the text and download the updated file.
